sounds.text: A small cute ghost hero comes back to life: four quick rising soft chime notes and one warm clear bell that rings out with a gentle sparkle tail. Hopeful and light, slightly eerie, short mobile game sting, clean, no speech, no vocals.
A paper doll bursts: a crisp papery rip and a soft pop, then three tiny wooden clacks of scraps falling.
A tiny stone-and-brass toy turret fires: one short bright 'pew' with a small mechanical click, dropping slightly in pitch.

sounds.ko: 한 번에 여러 적이 맞음 (4마리 이상)
sounds.text: Many small hits land almost together on a crowd of squishy ghosts: a rapid flurry of five or six soft rubbery thwacks, bouncy and quick.
Hitting a weak spot: a bright golden coin 'ching' with a quick sparkling ring over a small punchy tap.
One soft low heartbeat, 'lub-dub', muffled and tense, warning of low health.
A big healing burst: three quick rising soft bell chimes and a warm shimmering sparkle that fades gently.
A ghostly wisp of life being sucked back in: a reversed airy breath that swells and ends abruptly, eerie and hollow.
Two tiny soft glassy pings, low then high, like a small healing notification.
One clear high golden bell 'ting' with a short shimmer.
A magic bubble shield forms: a quick rising glassy 'vwip' then three tiny crystal glints.
A cartoon bonk on the head followed by three quick high chirps of little birds circling, cute and dizzy.
A quick crackle of fine ice crystals forming, crisp frosty sparkle, very short.
A curse settles on a target: a low wobbling hollow tone with a ghostly echo repeating and fading, uncanny and sinking.
A quick power-up: three rising soft plucked tones ending bright and upbeat.
An airy upward sweep of sparkles washing something clean, ending in one bright small ping.
A short heavy shove impact: a low punchy thud with a small air push.
Something being sucked inward: a short swelling whoosh of air that narrows and darkens toward a point.
A short blunt square buzzer honk, flat and attention-grabbing, like a cartoon taunt horn.
Small iron chain links rattling tight around a target: a quick metallic jingle-clank.
A thin taut string plucked: two delicate high glassy pings, sweet but slightly eerie.
Something small pops into existence: a tiny wooden click and a short soft rising 'boop'.

A small ghost hero falls and its soul drifts away: a slow sliding downward hollow tone, a dark minor bell toll, and a faint wordless breathy whisper fading into a soft reverb tail. Sad and eerie, not violent.
A distant muffled version of a ghost hero falling: a soft sliding downward tone and a dark minor bell toll, quieter and further away, fading gently.

Everyone comes back to life: a warm bright major chord of soft bells and gentle pads, a second higher sparkling chord layered on top, swelling and ringing out with shimmer. Uplifting short mobile game sting, clean, no speech, no vocals.

sounds.ko: 불꽃 개구리 시전 — 개굴 + 떨어지는 휘파람
sounds.text: A cute little frog croaks 'ribbit', then a whistling falling bomb sound slides downward.
A cartoon firecracker frog explodes: a fat, round, full-bodied boom with a thick low thump that lasts a moment and crackling sparks scattering, punchy and loud, not a thin pop.
A tiny fairy sprinkles healing dust: a quick rising cascade of eight delicate glass sparkle chimes with a soft airy shimmer tail.

sounds.ko: 수호 거북 시전 — 등껍질 똑 + 보호막
sounds.text: A small turtle taps its wooden shell 'tok', then a protective bubble rises with a glassy 'vwip' and a tiny ping.
A soft little owl hoots twice, 'hoo hoo', then a burst of icy chimes and crackling frost crystals.
A tiny stone golem sets up a turret: two quick mechanical clicks and a short rising servo whirr.
A small cat gives a short wobbly meow, then a dark swirling suction pulls inward and ends in a deep soft thump.

sounds.ko: 전투북 너구리 시전 — 북 세 번
sounds.text: Three quick punchy hits on a small taiko-style war drum, 'dum dum dum', tight and energetic.
A clock tick, a springy cartoon 'boing', then a quick flurry of tiny rising sparkles like time speeding up.
A small spooky monster appears: a short low muffled puff and a soft dull thump from below.
A monster's area attack slams down in a circle: a round low boom with a short dusty rumble.
A fast straight lunge: a sharp passing whoosh that ends in a heavy low thud.
A wide spraying swipe: a gritty scattering burst of debris and air fanning outward.
A deep hollow ground thump that rolls outward like a shockwave ring.

Starts instantly, no silence at the start: a monster's charged attack is broken, at the very first moment a bright glass pane shatters into tinkling shards, the loudest part, followed by a clean ringing chime that fades.
A rusty wheelchair bursts forward: a sharp squeal of a small wheel and a rattling clatter of loose metal.
A ghost blinks away: a quick reversed whoosh that sucks in and cuts off sharply.
One tiny dull electronic beep, like a cheap hospital monitor blip.
An old landline phone ring is cut short mid-ring, followed by a small soft puff of smoke.
A sheet of photocopy paper being quickly torn apart, crisp and papery.
A plastic mannequin falls apart: three quick hollow plastic clacks rising slightly in pitch.
A cartoon eyeball creature pops: a short soft wet squelch, goofy rather than gory.
A vending machine monster breaks: a hollow tin can clang with a small metallic rattle.
An old umbrella collapses: a quick fluttering flap of fabric and a soft rib snap.

sounds.ko: 한 번에 몬스터 여러 마리 처치
sounds.text: Several small spooky monsters vanish at once: a ripple of overlapping soft airy smoke poofs with a light sparkle at the end.

A mid-size horror boss appears in a cute ghost-story game: a short dissonant low brass stab, a deep boom and a swelling reversed cymbal rising into it, ominous with a short reverb tail. Mobile game sound effect, no speech, no vocals.
A big monster winds up: a deep wobbling rising growl and rumble that swells with tension.
A mid-size monster is defeated: a deep heavy boom and collapse, then a bright golden coin 'ching' with a sparkle as the reward drops.
A paper copy splits off: a quick papery slap and a small rising 'pop'.
A steady seamless loop of a deep tense heartbeat, 'lub-dub' about every 0.7 seconds, low and pounding, no start or end hit.
One small clean bell 'clink', bright and short, like filling a meter.

Starts instantly, no silence at the start: a huge boss is staggered, at the very first moment a big satisfying glass shatter and a deep resonant gong strike hit together, the loudest part; then a heavy low tone slides down into a rumble with a long ringing tail.

sounds.ko: 보스 그로기 중 — 머리 위 별 (반복)
sounds.text: A seamless loop of tiny cartoon stars twinkling around a dizzy head: light high sparkle pings, about four per second, steady, no start or end hit.
A big monster shakes off its daze: a low gravelly growl swelling then falling, with a rush of air.
Loud steady rumble of big ventilation fans and an escalator motor running in an empty mall at night, a constant low mechanical drone with a hollow echo. Seamless loop, no speech, no music.
Loud constant buzzing hum of old fluorescent ceiling lights in an empty office at night, a steady electrical drone with a faint flicker crackle. Seamless loop, no speech, no music.

Seamless ambience loop of an abandoned hospital ward: a low slow pulsing drone and a few sparse water drips echoing in a tiled hallway, cold and eerie. Steady texture with no start or end hit, no music, no speech, no vocals.

Loud, clearly audible steady background ambience loop, recorded close to the mic. Seamless ambience loop of a high city rooftop at night: steady hollow wind gently rising and falling, a faint otherworldly airy tone underneath. Steady texture with no start or end hit, no music, no speech, no vocals.

Seamless ambience loop of a deep ominous low drone with a slow throbbing undertone, heavy and menacing, like something huge breathing in the dark. Steady texture with no start or end hit, no music, no speech, no vocals.

Seamless ambience loop of an uncanny still room: two very low close tones beating slowly against each other in a soft wavering hum, quiet and unsettling. Steady texture with no start or end hit, no music, no speech, no vocals.
A sturdy cute ghost hero drops onto the battlefield: a low heavy rising whoosh ending in a solid weighty thump.
A nimble cute ghost hero lands lightly on the battlefield: a quick light whoosh ending in a crisp clicky snap, like a latch catching.

sounds.ko: 원거리딜러 근접 공격 (예비 — 지금은 거의 안 남)
sounds.text: A quick light swish of a wooden bow swatted at close range.
A gentle cute ghost hero floats down onto the battlefield: a soft airy rising swell ending in a gentle glassy chime sparkle.

sounds.ko: 힐러 근접 공격 (예비 — 지금은 거의 안 남)
sounds.text: A soft swoosh of a light wooden staff through the air with a faint tinkle of a tiny bell tied to it.
A playful cute ghost hero bounces onto the battlefield: a springy cartoon boing ending in a twinkly little pop.

sounds.ko: 서포터 근접 공격 (예비 — 지금은 거의 안 남)
sounds.text: A small baton flicked through the air: a quick whip with a springy rubbery twang at the end.

sounds.ko: 가디언 원거리 공격 (예비 — 지금은 거의 안 남)
sounds.text: A small iron shield edge flung forward: a short low whirl with a dull metallic ring.

sounds.ko: 팔라딘 원거리 공격 (예비 — 지금은 거의 안 남)
sounds.text: A gilded steel gauntlet flicks a small bolt of holy fire: a bright metallic shing with a short hot crackling sizzle.

sounds.ko: 워든 원거리 공격 (예비 — 지금은 거의 안 남)
sounds.text: A heavy iron chain lashed out: a short low rattling whip with a dark metallic clink.

sounds.ko: 블레이드 원거리 공격 (예비 — 지금은 거의 안 남)
sounds.text: A thin steel sword wave sent flying: a very quick sharp high ringing 'shing'.

sounds.ko: 버서커 원거리 공격 (예비 — 지금은 거의 안 남)
sounds.text: A crude heavy axe hurled end over end: a short low thick tumbling whoosh with a rough metallic edge.

sounds.ko: 섀도우 원거리 공격 (예비 — 지금은 거의 안 남)
sounds.text: A small shadow dagger thrown silently: a hushed dark swish with a faint muffled tick.
A wooden bow releases a feathered arrow: a tight string snap and a quick rising airy whizz.
A small antique flintlock pistol fires: a crisp dry powder pop with a tiny low thump, toy-like and punchy.
A small orb of holy light is cast: a soft warm bell 'ting' with a gentle glow shimmer.
A small syringe dart is fired: a quick light pneumatic 'pff' and a tiny bright glass-vial click.
A paper talisman flicked through the air: a crisp paper flutter and one small brass bell jingle, slightly eerie.
A single bright plucked lute string note sent flying, short and cheerful. Single mobile game sound effect, cute and punchy, clean and dry, no background noise, no speech, no vocals.
A small brass clockwork tick-tock and a quick glassy ping, like a tiny pocket-watch orb being launched.
A sharp loud twang of a tight thin wire plucked hard, a bright metallic ping that snaps forward. Single isolated sound effect, dry, no music.
